chunks: And he was asked about a man who performs ghusl (ritual bath), then afterward finds some wetness, while he had urinated before performing ghusl. He said:
He should perform wudu (ablution). But if he had not urinated before the ghusl, then he should repeat the ghusl.
ai.seo_question: What should a man do if he finds wetness after ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about finding wetness after ghusl. If the person had urinated before ghusl, only wudu is required; if he had not urinated beforehand, the ghusl must be repeated.
